name: StopTouch
description: The NPC takes back an agreement to be hugged or touched: they have had enough, it went further than they wanted, or they simply changed their mind. They may do this at any moment and owe no reason.
note: Living World touch consent (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1, off with MANTELLA_LW_TOUCH_CONSENT=0). Handled by the server (livingworld/touch/); the game ends the agreement and the player's hands count as unwelcome again.

source.description: The NPC who takes it back.

prompt: If you had let the player touch you and now want them to stop, begin your response with '{key}:'
